What degraded

  • The deck shipped at the round 3 cap at 7.09, 0.91 under the 8.0 top rung, and the art median of 6.5 sits under the 8.5 craft floor, which stands down at the cap.
  • Named by the judges and not fixed: frame 7 is the weakest image, frame 8 reads as type on a plate, frame 2 reads as a floor plan, frame 5 reads as a grid, frames 3 and 4 are lit evenly with the back wall's dark base behind them, and gold is used beyond its one meaning on 2, 7 and 9.
  • On the copy: frame 7 carries the blog's turnover line where the paper's operative minutes result (c12) belongs, the first comment's id list omits c12 though the caption states it, and frame 5's headline reads the 95% interval as bounds.
  • Six of the panel's round 2 and 3 judge cards were transcribed by hand from the judges' hand-backs because they came back under three different keys.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Houston Methodist's operating room AI and a study tying it to about 25 more cases a month, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

About 25 more surgeries a month.

That is an estimate, not a count. A Journal of Imaging study ties it to the image based AI Houston Methodist put in Walter Tower's 15 room cardiothoracic suite, four wall cameras to a room.

The paper puts the baseline at about 339 a month. Operative minutes showed no significant change. The hospital's blog says turnovers got shorter.

A change management program came with the cameras. The study can't say which did the work. The authors call the rise associated with the deployment, not caused by it. The hospital holds a minority equity interest in Apella, the vendor.

The study's 95% interval sizes the unknown. It runs from 8.3 to 41.0 more cases a month.

The deck draws each case of the month as one sterile container.

What would another Texas hospital want proven before mounting four cameras in every room?

#HoustonMethodist #Apella #OperatingRoom

Notes

The record. 35 items were due and all were re-verified, 3 of them rotten. tx-2026-0198 moved (Kodiak's readiness measure is 96 percent at the end of September, up from 93) and tx-2026-0186 moved (the FAA comment period closed on October 11th). 23 unreachable items had their boundary measured again, every one still refusing. Three items were admitted, all on primary sources: tx-2026-0222 (Houston Methodist's operating room camera study, today's deck), tx-2026-0223 (Texas A&M's junk post study) and tx-2026-0224 (Rice's plan for 40 more AI faculty). Nothing deferred. Selection. STAAR rescoring was the strongest lead of the morning and dedupe_check refused it, because carousel no. 38 ran on the same item on September 30th. The panel. Round 1 found one hard fail. The caption and slide 8 called Apella the vendor while the cited quote said only that the hospital owns part of Apella. The paper says it in its own words, so that sentence was added as c28 and c13 was cut back to what its quote proves. Rounds 2 and 3 found no hard fail and the deck ships at the round 3 cap. CI. The gates job went red on the PR's first head because this payload was not yet committed, which is the carousel no. 7 lesson. The payload was built and committed before the merge and the merge waited for CI green on the new head. Machine. No machine change was made this run. Six new items went to MACHINE_QUEUE.md and three repeats were raised. The weekly pass is not due (last run October 16th, 74 items queued). Did this run wait on a human? prompt_audit.py exited 1. 1,951 tool calls were measured and 24 had a permission decision slower than an auto-approval: 21 Agent spawns (the longest 20.6 s) and 3 Bash calls (about 1 s each), each released by a granted rule (Skill) and none refused. This reading was taken before the merge, so the merge call itself and this draft are not in it. No-stall hook: armed at 2026-10-20T05:07:08Z. At session start it judged the session unattended (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0), and the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED was 0. It refused nothing.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
